summary: Tamworth lookout built by the CCC in 1934 in Hemenway State Forest; NH Forestry staffed it until 1974; closed July 2026 for repairs and reopened July 28.

facts.design: Steel frame with wooden cabin (per the Tamworth Conservation Commission's 2026 maintenance log)

staffing.status: No regular staffing since NH Forestry ended its service in 1974; available for fire detection when needed

access.note: Reopened for use July 28, 2026 after a closure of about three weeks for repairs and paint; the closure notice said all trails to and across the summit would remain open

visit.drive_up: Parking on the side shoulder of Route 113A near the Big Pines Natural Area sign (Weirs Times)
visit.trail_note: Trails through Hemenway State Forest maintained by the Tamworth Conservation Commission; the path is steep near the tower

facts.agency: Town of Tamworth, NH (Tamworth Conservation Commission manages it)

events.note: Constructed by the CCC on Hemenway State Forest. The Register's Built field gives 1935; the 1934 construction date is used here
Transferred to the Town of Tamworth, on condition it remain available for fire detection when needed
Evaluated and found structurally sound; extraneous antennas and outdated solar panels removed
Closed for maintenance starting July 6, 2026, for about three weeks
Outside clapboards replaced, other repairs made, tower primed and painted; reopened July 28, 2026; volunteers finished most cabin painting in August

corrections.why: The Register's description and the Weirs Times both give 1934 for CCC construction; the Register's Built field says 1935. Proposed value follows the construction date. The editor may prefer to keep both values visible.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register description and Weirs Times say 1934 (CCC construction); the Register's Built field says 1935. The story uses 1934 and notes the Register's 1935 field.

notes_for_editor: Elevation is unresolved: the Register lists 525 ft (160 m) for the site, while the Weirs Times describes a 1,300-foot summit. The record's 160 m is left unchanged for the editor to check. Register coordinates (43.86, -71.26) differ from firelookout.org (43.87691, -71.29874) by about 3 km; not changed. The Forest Lookouts page for Great Hill has only a header and no body text, so it is not cited. Living New Deal and franklinsites were not read (Living New Deal returned HTTP 403). Access is public per the town's reopening notice; the story does not encourage climbing.
